observations: The MiniJinja `{% include %}` mechanism inside @-inlined prompts is fully supported end to end (TemplateIncludeResolver resolves relative to the including prompt; workflow_bundler's collect_bundled_template_includes discovers the static include closure, so server-side run bundles carry the included file automatically) — recorded as mx-bf9c40; dynamic (non-literal) includes would NOT be bundled, so the PROJECT_FACTS include must stay a static string literal.

The reviewer prompt's ADR-0019 axis previously hardcoded engine source paths; they now live in PROJECT_FACTS 'engine credential surfaces' — a port to another project only needs that block edited, but reviewers should still verify the axis against the host project's actual engine.
